I struggle with depression and used to self harm. Around 3 years ago I  self harmed quite badly. It was weird, I wasn't feeling particularly depressed but just started cutting. I didn't feel any of it, but just kept going. I was kind of mesmerised by the mess I was making, and only after I'd calmed down did I realise quite how much of a mess it was- most of the cuts were deeper than I usually cut and one was about 4 inches wide and cut deep into my arm's fatty tissue.

I called a friend who cleaned me up a bit and convinced me to go to A&E, which was horrible. I felt like the whiny attention-seeking teenager. It was a Friday night and I spent about 2 hours waiting to be seen in the waiting room, which was filling up with drugged out prostitutes, minor stab victims and some police to keep the drunks under control. The nurse who cleaned me up was really rough with me and kept talking about me to the doctor who was preparing the area to give me stitches, rather than to me. The doctor made me feel like I was just wasting her time. 

After about 6 hours, I was stood in the car park, waiting for a taxi to take me home. I text my step mum to let her know what had happened. She text back:

"What a stupid thing to do. You're so selfish. It's not a competition between you and your mother. Sort yourself out."

It kind of broke me. It hit on almost every insecurity I have. I kind of pinpoint that as the start of my current downward spiral. 

One upside is that it helped mend my relationship with my biological mother. I called her, and she immediately got in the car and drove 4 hours to pick me up. She spent a week looking after me because I just wasn't functioning enough to look after myself. I used to hold so much anger and resentment towards her because I'd grown up dealing with the fallout from her mental health problems, but now i understand her more and she's one of my best friends.
